method: Read-only byte hashing and terminal metadata/type/stage inspection. Per-query and validation metric values were not reported or aggregated. No JVM, benchmark, compression or source changes.

terminationInspection.interpretation: No searched termination marker is present in the saved partial console/GC logs. The runner normally writes process.json in its finally block, but absence of that receipt does not identify an operating-system exit status, signal, JVM failure or external termination cause. Saved launch PID is a child PID in its execution namespace; tool handle 13272 is not treated as an OS PID.
